component_findings.current_continuity: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-2--python): Python has abundant, independently verifiable production deployment evidence at extreme scale across multiple industry-leading companies and domains (social media, streaming, cloud storage, ride-hailing, aerospace), plus a large, work-majority professional survey population and growing production-web-framework adoption. The primary limitation noted in the source data itself is that Python's server-side web-hosting *market share* (per W3Techs) is a small single-digit percentage and includes a documented long tail of unpatched Python 2 deployments, which is why the score is 96/100 rather than a perfect score: overwhelming production evidence in application/backend/data domains, with a caveat o
component_findings.deployment_depth: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-2--python): Independently documented, large-scale production use of Python exists at Instagram/Meta (backend serving over a billion daily users via Django), Netflix (data engineering, A/B testing, content delivery, and a failover system that shifts AWS-region traffic in minutes), Spotify (backend services and data pipelines, plus PyCon/EuroPython sponsorship), Dropbox (desktop client and backend architecture), Uber/Lyft/Pinterest (real-time location/routing and application-layer services), NASA (CAE/CAD/PDM infrastructure and the OpenMDAO framework), and Google/Amazon (recommendation engines and backend systems).

component_findings.build_test_coverage: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-2--python): Python exhibits essentially complete third-party tool coverage across every standard category (IDE, editor extension, linter/formatter, type-checker, package manager, debugger, profiler, test framework, CI/CD integration), with multiple competing, actively maintained options in most categories and a documented pattern of continued new-tool investment (uv/Ruff rapid adoption). This represents near-maximal ecosystem tool maturity, scored 97/100; the deduction reflects that a handful of niche/embedded or highly specialized tooling gaps still exist relative to a hypothetical perfect score.
